metadata.selection: the 100 MAIN screen concepts with >=1 complete-case closure_res row; all their panel rows kept (STRICT/SENSITIVITY flags included). Full panel: 659 rows / 168 concepts.

row_count_decision.F3_rule: if complete-case closure_res leaves < 150 screen MAIN concepts or < 500 rows -> closure_res_imp co-primary
row_count_decision.coprimary_rule: D1_SUPPORTED_SCREEN requires the pre-declared rule to hold for closure_res AND for closure_res_imp on the same outcome (conservative conjunction; no forking)
row_count_decision.F4_rule: if n* < 20 in > 40% of MAIN rows -> Y1r floor 10 and Y1r20 -> Y1r10
